entries.content: The bread at the stall carries a warm, yeasty aroma, faintly sweet with a hint of toasted crust, inviting and comforting in the cool air of Brineward lane. Bram the baker works behind the counter wearing a simple, well-worn linen shirt rolled up at the sleeves and a stained leather apron tied firmly around his waist, his hands dusted with flour from the day's baking.

scene.summary: A bread stall stands at the edge of the lane. Bram the baker is working behind the counter. The stall does not describe the smell or his clothes.
visible_facts: A bread stall stands at the edge of the lane.
Bram the baker is working behind the counter.

topics.text: Bram sells the morning loaves from this stall.
